preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the enableTrading() function to enable trading for all users. This bypasses the initial restriction where only authorized addresses (those excluded from fees) can transfer tokens while trading is disabled.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The BossBaby contract has a tradingEnabled flag that restricts token transfers for non-excluded addresses. Initially false, only the owner can enable trading via enableTrading(). The exploit requires becoming the owner (or impersonating them) to call this function.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the current owner using vm.prank() and call enableTrading() to set tradingEnabled to true.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call enableTrading() on the target contract. 4. Verify tradingEnabled is now true.
